name: GPT Healthcare Ltd
title: GPT Healthcare Ltd - 544131 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mature hospitals earn 23.06% EBITDA margin ex-Raipur, but Raipur's FY26 EBITDA loss of INR13.8 crores drags the reported margin to 18.84%; guidance hinges on Raipur breakeven by Q3 FY27.

utilisation.quote: The overall network occupancy stood at 45.87%. However, excluding the Raipur Hospital, the occupancy remained at a healthy 55.9%.

capex.quote: The capex per bed for the Jamshedpur hospital would be around INR70 lakhs per bed.

triggers.label: Jamshedpur 150 beds, capex INR70 lakh/bed
triggers.quote: we are targeting to add around 150 beds through our Jamshedpur hospital, which is expected to be commissioned by quarter 4 of FY27.

triggers.label: Network occupancy 45.87% (ex-Raipur 55.9%)
triggers.quote: The overall network occupancy stood at 45.87%. However, excluding the Raipur Hospital, the occupancy remained at a healthy 55.9%.

triggers.label: ARPOB INR37,000 → INR39,200
triggers.quote: the ARPOB increased from INR 37,000 to INR 39,200

triggers.label: Raipur breakeven Q3 FY27 at ~25% occupancy
triggers.quote: We expect the hospital to breakeven around the 25% mark, you're right.

guidance.quote: we expect the company to do a 15% increase on a Y-o-Y basis.
We expect the ARPOB to grow by around 8% through a mix of tariff increase as well as specialty optimization.
we expect the EBITDA to move by around 100 basis points.
In FY27, we expect to close the year at around 30% occupancy levels at the Raipur hospital.
We are hopeful that by quarter 3 of this financial year, we should be breaking even on a monthly basis at an operational level.
